scope: Causal diagnostics only; no new training, runtime change, policy promotion or headset deployment.

findings.claim: Unchanged pose imitation competes with lifting a low reference foot.
findings.strength: Measured local reward tradeoff, not full dynamic return or causal explanation of all PPO outcomes.
findings.details: Real live-reference sequence26103..26125, left sole0.916..1.491mm. Fixed-root, fixed-foot-orientation IK lift to65mm; exact position formulas and resolved weights from actual v2 trainer. Clearance gain0.057..0.079, joint/local+global key imitation loss0.312..0.540. Other rewards/future dynamics omitted.

findings.claim: Catch-up velocity/yaw correction alone does not reliably elicit coherent corrective footsteps under held leg references.
findings.strength: Controlled six native rollouts, one installed policy and episode; no generalization claim to v2 candidates.
findings.details: Common exact fork qpos/qvel and teacher-forced history. Held stop:61cm→56cm error in6s despite0.4m/s command, last2s projected velocity-0.00077m/s, maximum leg torque35.85%cap. Replacing only leg references with recorded4..10s motion causes steps but position error grows88cm. Closed-loop correction subsequently responds to changed robot state. This shows leg-reference/velocity coupling; spliced motion is not a proposed fix.

findings.claim: Foot morphology frame error already documented upstream of policy remains relevant.
findings.strength: Prior deterministic retarget audit, not a newly found error; correction improved reference clearance but degraded one physical slip comparison.
findings.details: Do not conclude that raising references alone fixes walking.

user_scope_correction: Current legs are Meta Virtual/Generative Legs; there is no reliable intentional kick input to preserve. Focus on locomotion, turning and catch-up. Future direct leg-action modes are separate.

next_design.flow: GMR reference -> learned lower-body reference adapter conditioned on causal Meta history, robot state and catch-up intent -> TWIST2 -> physics
requirements: Use the same corrected pose reference in policy observation and imitation objective.
Keep independent desired displacement/heading, temporal continuity, support and progress objectives so adapter cannot make standing still the new target.
Correct support/transfer trajectories, not a constant vertical lift of both feet.
First isolate adapter learning against a frozen tracker, then assess whether joint finetuning is needed.
Training must include stationary-operator catch-up and turning inputs used in deployment.
Fix deterministic coordinate/model issues separately rather than expect network to absorb them.

related_work.title: ReActor: Reinforcement Learning for Physics-Aware Motion Retargeting
related_work.relevance: Joint retarget-parameter and tracking-policy optimization; evidence for feasibility, not ready Quest adapter. Constant-in-time retarget parameters; auxiliary root forces in retarget generation; downstream hardware controller trained separately.
